I've updated the record and replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-random message.

- **What the brain held:** one saved fact, from Tobias's #central-team post this morning, that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal was for 382 seats.
- **What I changed:** I saved a new fact that the renewal is for 84 seats, noting it corrects the 382 figure and pointing back to his correction message. I then retired the 382 fact, so the brain now has only 84 as the current figure. The old fact is kept in the audit trail.
- **Reply:** I told him the record now says 84 seats, the old figure is retired, and nothing more is needed from him.

The seat count is an account fact, not a money figure, so repeating it in a Central team channel was fine. Every member of #central-random is also in #central-team, so mentioning that post told no one anything new. I didn't touch his original #central-team post.
